title: Grateful Dead Live at Frost Amphitheatre on 1982-10-09

ai_review.summary: Crisp soundboard capture of an electric 1982 show – Truckin’ > Other One > Dew, Throwing Stones > Touch of Grey and a monster Estimated/Eyes jam steal the spotlight.
ai_review.review: The recording is a clean, patched SBD source that most reviewers describe as crisp and excellent despite occasional minor drop‑outs.  Musically the concert is hailed as one of the band’s finest mid‑80s outings, with high energy throughout and standout performances of Truckin’ → Other One → Dew, Throwing Stones → Touch of Grey, Estimated → Eyes and a soaring Space/Drums jam.  Jerry’s vocal grit, Phil’s “bomb” bass work and Brent’s vocal fire are repeatedly praised.

ai_rating.rationale: Over a dozen enthusiastic 5‑star reviews praise both the show and recording; only a few modest scores note minor flaws, yielding an overall rating in the high‑4 range.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Patched SBD with crystal‑clear mix; reviewers mention crispness, occasional slight drop‑outs or frequency dips but no major issues.

poor_songs: Music Never Stopped (unfocused for some listeners)
show_quality.setlist_flow: Tight, well‑sequenced set with a powerful second‑set opener and seamless segues; the show builds to an intense jam climax before a solid encore.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly praised for gritty vocal delivery, strong guitar tone, occasional lyric flubs but overall high‑energy performance.
band_member_comments.Phil: "Bomb" bass work highlighted on Estimated/Eyes and throughout the set; noted as a key driver of the jam intensity.
band_member_comments.Bob: Comments on his quirky vocal interjections (e.g., On the Road Again) and unusual lyrical twists; generally seen as adding character.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent’s vocal power on Deal noted; overall keyboard work described as solid though not spotlighted.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill and Mickey praised for a strong, propulsive rhythm section, especially during the Space/Drums segment.
